title: FAST-DS 2026: Disclosing Overseas Crypto Assets
description: The Foreign Assets Disclosure Scheme (FAST-DS) 2026 offers a window for eligible taxpayers to voluntarily disclose undisclosed foreign assets and income. Whet.

faq.q: What is the primary purpose of FAST-DS 2026?
faq.a: The scheme aims to provide a window for taxpayers to voluntarily disclose previously unreported foreign assets and income, thereby regularising their tax affairs and avoiding severe penalties under the Black Money Act, 2015.

faq.q: Can all types of foreign crypto assets be disclosed under this scheme?
faq.a: Generally, if the crypto assets represent value, are held outside India, and were acquired from undisclosed income or were themselves undisclosed, they are likely covered. The specific conditions, including the source of funds and residential status, must be met.

faq.q: What are the risks of not disclosing unreported overseas crypto?
faq.a: Non-disclosure can lead to significant penalties, including tax at a high rate, additional fines, and even prosecution with imprisonment under the Black Money Act, 2015, if the assets are discovered by tax authorities.

faq.q: Is there a specific tax rate or penalty for disclosures under FAST-DS 2026?
faq.a: Yes, disclosure schemes typically specify a combined tax and penalty rate that is applicable to the value of the undisclosed foreign asset. This rate is usually lower than what would be imposed if the assets were discovered through an investigation.

faq.q: Does this scheme apply to NRIs?
faq.a: The applicability to NRIs depends on their residential status at the time the assets were acquired and the source of funds. If an NRI acquired crypto with legitimate foreign income while being a non-resident, it generally wouldn't be subject to this scheme. However, individual circumstances vary.

faq.q: What if my crypto was acquired through legitimate means but I forgot to report it?
faq.a: Even if acquired legitimately, failure to report foreign assets (if required) can lead to compliance issues. FAST-DS 2026 might still offer a mechanism to regularise such oversights, depending on the scheme's specific terms and conditions.

faq.q: What is the deadline for disclosing under FAST-DS 2026?
faq.a: The specific deadlines for FAST-DS 2026 would be announced through official notifications from the CBDT or Ministry of Finance. Taxpayers must closely monitor these announcements on official government websites.
